Bug_Title: FI: Finalizer should be protected, not public (FI_PUBLIC_SHOULD_BE_PROTECTED)
Bug_Details:
A class's finalize() method should have protected access,
 not public. finalize()
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the generated code by declaring the finalize() method with public access instead of protected. This violates the rule FI_PUBLIC_SHOULD_BE_PROTECTED.
Trigger_Explanation: The test calls the showBug method of the FinalizerBugExample class, which triggers the bug due to the public finalize method. The test will pass, but the presence of the public finalize method violates the coding standard and can lead to issues in garbage collection.
